Second TermAl runner on DL560 (Fable2 #4222, 2026-11-04 02:36Z, created on Greg's word): Codex 6, host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-6, same settings and brief as Codex 3 (session-3); reports PREPARED, START, END to the requester and Fable2. It can't read mail while inside a FULL. Passed its first job, N3's FULL. Don't use session-5 (held at an approval). Don't move a job queued at Codex 3 without withdrawing it and getting an answer: a withdrawal crossed a START there. Codex 3's long turns delay queued wakes by tens of minutes, not hours (Fable2 #4223).

Windows B (session-9) cleanup: Engram::Fable's ban under w-789a7d0e554d stays on that host (Fable2 #4235). Each cleanup there needs a named release from the owner; I can't release by general wording. Named so far: t/j/f8f1ac00, t/j/d456f531, t/j/2707075c, t/.tmp/n1a, t/.tmp/n2a, t/.tmp/n3a. t/j/441d17a7 and n3f stay until a named release. Merger3's broader reading was not adopted.
